subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should the description-only linked PR fully satisfy this issue, or must the message tool also expose a plugin-aware enum before the issue closes?
rationale: The demonstrated provider-versus-destination confusion is addressed by description metadata, while enum support is optional in the report and introduces plugin-extensibility and schema-loading tradeoffs requiring explicit scope judgment.

options.title: Land description only
options.body: Treat the focused description-and-test patch as sufficient and defer enum support unless subsequent evidence shows models still misuse the parameter.

options.title: Require dynamic enum
options.body: Keep the issue open after the description lands until a lightweight plugin-aware enum is designed and tested.

recommendation.title: Land description only
recommendation.body: Treat the focused description-and-test patch as sufficient and defer enum support unless subsequent evidence shows models still misuse the parameter.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the central schema and routing behavior and already participated in this issue’s review context.
